Select exact IC50 activities in nM for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Join docs to activities to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records to activities to obtain compound_key. Return columns: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Filter by target CHEMBL5251, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', standard_relation = '=', and docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
